subject: MAP: Prompt kit lending window & final acceptance timebox
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.z@verdantcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Prompt kit lending window & final acceptance timebox

Hi Emma —

Following up from our demo, attaching the prompt kit and an initial MAP to get aligned on timelines and usage constraints so your QA team can run the acceptance suite. High level:

- We can provide an ephemeral prompt pack (promptkit-v2.zip) and a small seed dataset for 30-day evaluation access.
- Usage constraints: no production traffic, max 5 named testers, no model redistribution, local results may be logged for debugging but must be deleted after the window.
- Acceptance window: 2-week hard run once you receive assets; we’ll agree pass/fail gates in checklist (attached).

Please confirm that Verdant is OK with the 30-day ephemeral access and the 2-week acceptance run (we can shift if procurement needs a different cadence). If yes, we’ll send the MAP doc for signature and provision access to the S3 staging bucket.

Attachments: promptkit-v2.zip (archive), MAP_Verdant_v1.1.docx (draft), acceptance-checklist.csv

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Zhao <emma.z@verdantcommerce.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: qa-team@verdantcommerce.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Prompt kit lending window & final acceptance timebox

Sofia —

Thanks for the materials and the clear plan. Quick questions from the QA lead (copied):

1) Can we get the asset retention clause in the MAP to specify deletion confirmation (screenshot or S3 lifecycle log) once the 30 days end?
2) For the 2-week acceptance run, can we request a 3-day buffer after the run for our security review before signing off?
3) We have one additional internal tester (so 6 total) — is there flexibility to add one more named user?

If we can get answers on the above, procurement will push the DocuSign and we’ll start the run next Monday.

Best,
Emma Zhao
Director, ML QA — Verdant Commerce
emma.z@verdantcommerce.com

Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Prompt kit lending window & final acceptance timebox — Verdant asks

Team — forwarding Verdant’s reply (below). Short asks:

- Retention confirmation: they want explicit confirmation (screenshot or lifecycle log). We can provide an S3 lifecycle deletion record and a short deletion confirmation email from infra. OK to include that in the MAP as required evidence.
- Buffer: they request a 3-day security review buffer after the 2-week run before final sign-off. I think that’s acceptable; adjust acceptance schedule to include that buffer.
- Extra user: they want +1 tester (total 6). Current provisioning plan is for 5 named testers under the ephemeral access ACLs. We need sign-off on making the ACL one slot larger for Verdant. Ben, can you confirm any cost/OPS impact for an extra seat?

Also, if procurement pushes DocuSign quickly, I want to pre-stage the access bucket and the promptkit download link so we can start within 48 hours of signature.

Cheers —
Sofia

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Prompt kit lending window & final acceptance timebox — confirmed

Emma —

Thanks for the quick turn. We’re aligned on all three requests and I’ve updated the MAP draft accordingly:

- Retention confirmation: MAP section 5 now requires an S3 lifecycle deletion log plus a short signed confirmation from Redwood infra within 7 calendar days of the 30-day window ending.
- Security buffer: acceptance timeline now includes a 3-day security review window after the 2-week acceptance run. We’ll mark the final acceptance date as "Acceptance + 3 days".
- Extra tester: we can expand the ephemeral ACL to 6 named testers for Verdant. No change to pricing or infra footprint for a single additional seat.

Next steps: I’ve uploaded the updated MAP (MAP_Verdant_v1.2.docx) and the same promptkit under the staging folder and initiated a DocuSign envelope. Links below — will send the envelope ID once DocuSign sends us the audit trail.

Attachments/Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-map-verdant (MAP_Verdant_v1.2.docx, acceptance-checklist.csv)
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/templates/fake-ds-link (envelope pending)

Emma — if procurement signs the envelope today, we’ll provision the S3 pre-stage and send download credentials within 24 hours of signature.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
